cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the SEO Specialist position at Netrex Solutions. Your emphasis on technical audits, keyword strategy, and content optimization for both your own site and client projects aligns closely with my experience.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and have worked on e-commerce and consultancy sites, using keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. At Knowledge Experts (KXP), I ran SEO analyses and reported on performance for enterprise clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, using Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

My freelance work includes building and optimizing mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file. I also ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I have a technical background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and use HTML/CSS to communicate effectively with developers. I'm also comfortable with structured data, site speed, crawlability, and indexing fundamentals.

I hold Semrush certifications in SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit, along with Google Analytics GA4 and Google Ads Search. I'm eager to bring my mix of technical SEO, content, and AI search visibility to Netrex Solutions and help drive measurable organic growth for your clients.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
